note: Non-NULL handle, count +1: the release helper runs with count -1 and only drops the refcount 2->1 (clearing *handle), then the exts.w/cmp/pl gate frees the handle itself through 0x8c01032c. Layout: H=0x8c201000 holds object 0x8c201100 whose refcount at +8 is 2. H-4 holds a size of 8 and H-8 points at itself so free's coalesce cmp/pz sees 0xfffffff9 and skips; the malloc top pointer at 0x8c2b1ef8 is 0x8c2b2000 with a zero size word so the bin walk stops immediately.
